csv_scope_of_work: The Housing Opportunities Commission of Montgomery County, Maryland ( HOC or the Commission ) seeks a qualified Construction Manager to provide preconstruction management services consistent with the industry-accepted role of a Construction Manager (CM) for the renovation of Westwood Towers apartments located at 4501 Westbard Avenue, Bethesda, MD 20816 in Montgomery County, MD. The selected CM will act as the Owner s representative on all preconstruction matters related to the project including but not limited to the procurement process for a General Contractor (GC) and negotiation of the GC contract
